book.title: Rongamwahu me Ntingdier sang rehn MADIU

content: Tohndoadoahk en nan Mwetin Wain
“Wehin Koht rasehng soumwet en wain emen me sangkeneiong rapahki tohndoadoahk en nan eh mwetin wain.
Ih eri inoukihong tohndoadoahk ko me e pahn pwainkin irail toala ehu rahn ehu; e ahpw kadarirailpeseng nan eh mwetin waino.
E ahpw pil pwurehng kohieila kulok duwau nan wasahn netinet kan, oh kilangada ekei aramas me mwomwohd mwahl;
e ahpw ndaiong irail, ‘Kumwail pil kohwei iang doadoahk nan ei mwetin waino, I pahn pwainohng kumwail duwen me pwung.’
Irail eri kohla. A e pil pwurehng kohieila kulok eisek riau oh kulok siluh, e ahpw pwurehng wia soahng me e wia nimensengo.

A nin soutik, kolahng kulok limau, e pil pwuralahng wasahn netinet kan, oh pil diarada ekei aramas me pil mwomwohd mwahl. Ih eri idek rehrail, ‘Dahme kumwail mwomwohd mwahlki oh kauwelahr ahnsou sohte wia mehkot rahnwet pwon?’
Irail ahpw sapeng, nda, ‘Ahki sohte me men koadoadoahkih kiht.’ Ih eri ndaiong irail, ‘Eri, kumwail pil kohwei iang doadoahk nan ei mwetin waino.’
“Wasa lao soutikpene, soumwet en waino ahpw ndaiong nah sounkohwa, ‘Ekerpene tohndoadoahk kan, ke ahpw pwainohng irail tepisang me kohdo mwuhr kan lao lel rehn me kohdo mahs ako.’
Me tapihada doadoahk kulok limau, emente ale toala ehu, ihr koaros.
A me tapihada doadoahk sang nimenseng re lao leledo, pwe re en ale pweipwei, re kihkihong me ar pweipwei pahn laudsang en mehn mwuhr ko—re ahpw pil alehte toala ehu emenemen irail.
Ni ar ale nair mwohni ko, re ahpw tapihada lipahnedih soumwet en waino, ndinda,
‘Aramas pwukat, re doadoahk awateieu, a kiht, se pwangada doadoahk rahnwet pwon pahn ketipin—komw ahpw kihong kiht soangen pweipweiteieu!’
Soumweto ahpw sapeng emen irail, nda, ‘Nahn, kaidehn sapwung ehu me I wiahiong uhk. Kita seu pwungkipene me e pahn toala ehu rahn ehu?
Ale pweinomwen oh kohkohwei ni imwomwo. Pwe nsenei, ma I men pwainohng me pwandodo kat duwehte uwen me I pwainohng uhk.
Ia duwe, e seu pwung I en doadoahngki nei mwohni kat nin duwen nsenei? De ke peirinki ei kadek?’”
Sises eri kaimwisekala eh mahsen, mahsanih, “Eri, mehn mwuri kan pahn mwowehla, oh mehn mwowe kan pahn mwurihla.”
Kesilipak en Sises eh ketin Kohpada duwen eh pahn Pwoula
Ni Sises eh pahn ketiketdalahng Serusalem, e ahpw ketin kelehpwla rehn sapwellime tohnpadahk ehk riemeno wasa kis nanialo, oh mahsanihong irail,
“Kumwail kilang, pwe kitail kohkolahng Serusalem, wasa me Nein-Aramas pahn pengpengla rehn samworo lapalap akan oh sounkawehwe kan en Kosonnedo. Re pahn kadeikada pwe en kamakamala;
re ahpw pahn pangala rehn mehn liki kan pwe en wiahla mehn kepit rehrail, pwe en wowoki oh kalohpwuwala; ahpw ni kesiluhwen rahn e pahn iasada.”
Pekipek en Ihn emen
Eri, inen nein Sepedi ko ahpw patohdo rehn Sises; pwutak riemeno iang ara nohno. Liho eri poaridi mwohn Sises pwe en wia eh pekipek.

Sises eri keinemwe rehn liho, “Dahme ke anahne?” A liho sapeng, patohwan, “Maing, komw inoukihong ie me ei tungoal pwutak riemenet en iang mwohd mpomwi nan mwoalomwi, emen ni palimaun, a emen ni palimeing, ni omw pahn wiahla Nanmwarki.”
Sises ahpw ketin sapeng pwutak ko, mahsanih, “Kumwa sehse dahme kumwa pekipekien. Kumwa kak nim dahl me I nektehn pahn nim?” Ira patohwanohng, “Ei Maing, se kak patohwan nim.”

A Sises ketin mahsanihong ira, “Me mwahu, kumwa pahn iang nim nimei dahlet, ahpw sohte ahiong kilelehdi ihs me pahn mwohd ni palimaun oh palimeingi, pwe met pwaisen irailte me Semei ketin onopadahng.”
Ni tohnpadahk ehk teiko ar rongada met, re inenen lingeringerda pahn pirieno.
Sises eri malipeirailpene koaros oh mahsanihong irail, “Kumwail ese duwen nin sampah wet kaun kan kin ahneki manaman en kaunda tohn ar wehi kan, oh me lapalap akan ar kin kakaun irail.
A e sohte pahn duwehte rehmwail. Mehmen me men lapalap rehmwail, e pahn papah meteikan;
a mehmen rehmwail me men soumasala, e uhdahn pahn wiahla lidu—
duwehte Nein-Aramas me ketido, kaidehn pwe aramas akan en papah, a pwe en papah aramas akan; oh pwe en tounmeteikihla moure, pwe me ngeder en maiauda.”
Sises ketin Kamwahwihala Ohl Maskun Riemen
Ni arail ketiketla sang Seriko, lapalahn pokon ehu idawehnla Sises.
A iet, ohl maskun riemen me wie mwomwohd ni keilenialo, rongada me Sises ketiket kohla wasao, ira ahpw ngihl laud patohwanohng, “Maing, komw me kisehn kadaudok en Depit, komw ketin kupwurei kiht!”
Pokono eri kidahweirahda oh ndahng ira en nennenla. A ira ahpwte kalaudehla ngilara ko, ndinda, “Maing, komwi me kisehn kadaudok en Depit, komw ketin kupwurei kiht!”
Sises eri ketin uhdi oh malipeiradohng reh, mahsanih, “Dahme kumwa anahne I en wiahiong kumwa?”
A ira patohwanohng, “Maing, se men kilangada wasa!”
Sises eri ketin kupwureirahla oh ketin sair pwoaren masara ko; ni ahnsowohte pwoaren masara ko pa pehdpeseng; ira eri kilangada wasa oh idawehnla Sises.
